business._note: Business-case settings used by npm run scenarios. IDs refer to docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md.
business._annualMix_note: BIZ-01: a year is 12 periods of 20 shifts; 4 periods with a supplier outage behave like 'both', the other 8 like 'demand-swing' (SUP-02: 4 outages per year).
business._annualFromQuarter_note: More realistic annual view (BIZ-02): 4 x the 60-shift quarter scenario with breakdowns and one outage; starting stock is given once per quarter. Also shown with end stock valued at EUR 45 (COST-04 sensitivity).
